title.zh: 卷一百十三 列傳第五十一: 完顏賽不 內族:完顏白撒一名承裔 赤盞合喜
title.en: Volume 113 Biographies 51: Wanyan Saibu; Same Clan: Wanyan Baisa (Also Named Chengyi); Chizhan Hexi
title.raw: 卷一百十三 列傳第五十一: 完顏賽不 內族:完顏白撒一名承裔 赤盞合喜 Volume 113 Biographies 51: Wanyan Saibu; Same Clan: Wanyan Baisa (Also Named Chengyi); Chizhan Hexi

sentences.zh: 完顏賽不

translations.literal: Wanyan Saibu
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Saibu

sentences.zh: 完顏賽不，始祖弟保活里之後也。

translations.literal: Wanyan Saibu was a descendant of Baohuoli, the founding ancestor's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Saibu was descended from Baohuoli, younger brother of the dynastic founder.

sentences.zh: 狀貌魁偉，沉厚有大略。

translations.literal: His appearance was imposing and tall; he was steady and deep, with great strategic capacity.
translations.idiomatic: He was tall and imposing in bearing, steady in temperament, and possessed of considerable strategic vision.

sentences.zh: 初補親衛軍，章宗時，選充護衛。

translations.literal: At first he was enrolled in the Personal Guard; under Emperor Zhangzong he was selected to serve as an imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered the Personal Guard, and under Emperor Zhangzong was chosen to serve among the imperial guards.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年八月，由宿直將軍爲甯化州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Mingchang, he went from Night-Duty General to prefect of Ninghua.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Mingchang 1 (1190), he was moved from Night-Duty General to prefect of Ninghua.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷武衛軍副都指揮使。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to deputy commander-in-chief of the Martial Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed deputy commander-in-chief of the Martial Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 泰和二年，轉胡里改路節度使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taihe he became military commissioner of the Huligai Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 2 (1202) he was made military commissioner of the Huligai Circuit.

sentences.zh: 四年，升武衛軍都指揮使，尋爲殿前左副都點檢。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to commander-in-chief of the Martial Guard Army, and soon after became left deputy chief inspector before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he rose to commander-in-chief of the Martial Guard Army, and shortly thereafter became left deputy chief inspector of the Palace Corps.

sentences.zh: 及平章僕散揆伐宋，爲右翼都統。

translations.literal: When Participation Councillor Pusan Kui campaigned against Song, he served as commander of the right wing.
translations.idiomatic: When Participation Councillor Pusan Kui invaded Song, he served as overall commander of the right wing.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，宋將皇甫斌遣率步騎數萬由確山、褒信分路侵蔡，聞郭倬、李爽之敗，阻溱水不敢進。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, the Song general Huangfu Bin led tens of thousands of infantry and cavalry by separate routes from Queshan and Baoxin to raid Cai; hearing of the defeats of Guo Zhuo and Li Shuang, they were blocked at the Zhen River and did not dare advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year six, the Song general Huangfu Bin led several tens of thousands of foot and horse by separate routes from Queshan and Baoxin against Cai; on hearing of Guo Zhuo and Li Shuang's defeats, his force halted at the Zhen River and dared not advance.

sentences.zh: 於是，揆遣賽不及副統尚廄局使蒲鮮萬奴、深州刺史完顏達吉不等以騎七千往擊之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Kui sent Saibu together with deputy commander Puxian Wannu of the Imperial Stables Bureau and the prefect of Shenzhou, Wanyan Daji, and others, with seven thousand horsemen to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Kui then dispatched Saibu, together with deputy commander Puxian Wannu of the Imperial Stables Bureau, Shenzhou prefect Wanyan Daji, and others, with seven thousand cavalry to attack them.

sentences.zh: 會溱水漲，宋兵扼橋以拒，賽不等謀潛師夜出，達吉不以騎涉水出其右，萬奴等出其左。

translations.literal: As it happened the Zhen River had risen; the Song troops held the bridge to block them. Saibu and the others planned to move troops out secretly by night: Daji led cavalry across the water on their right, while Wannu and the rest came out on their left.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhen had swollen, and Song troops held the bridge against them. Saibu and his colleagues planned a night march: Daji forded with cavalry on the right while Wannu and the rest emerged on the left.

sentences.zh: 賽不度其軍畢渡，乃率副統阿魯帶以精兵直趨橋，宋兵不能遏，比明大潰。

translations.literal: When Saibu judged that his army had all crossed, he led deputy commander Arudai with picked troops straight for the bridge; the Song troops could not stop them, and by daybreak they were utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Once Saibu saw his forces fully across, he led deputy commander Arudai with elite troops straight at the bridge; the Song could not hold them, and by dawn they were in full rout.

sentences.zh: 萬奴以兵斷真陽路，諸軍追擊至陳澤，斬首二萬級，獲戰馬雜畜千餘。

translations.literal: Wannu used troops to cut the Zhenyang road; the armies pursued to Chenze, beheading twenty thousand, and captured more than a thousand war horses and miscellaneous livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Wannu blocked the road to Zhenyang, and the armies pursued as far as Chenze, taking twenty thousand heads and more than a thousand war horses and other livestock.

sentences.zh: 兵還，進爵一級，賜金幣甚厚。

translations.literal: When the army returned, his noble rank was raised one step and he was given gold and coin in great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return his noble rank was raised one step, and he received a lavish grant of gold and coin.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，拜同簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he was appointed co-signatory for Marshalate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Zhenyou era he was appointed co-signatory of the Marshalate.

sentences.zh: 三年，遷知臨洮府事，兼陝西路副統軍。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to administer Linzhou prefecture and concurrently served as deputy overall commander of the Shaanxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made administrator of Linzhou prefecture and concurrently deputy overall commander of the Shaanxi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 上召見諭曰：「卿向在西京，盡心爲國，及治華州，亦嘗宣力，今始及三品。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned him and instructed him, saying: "You formerly at the Western Capital devoted your heart to the state, and in governing Huazhou you also once exerted your strength; only now have you reached the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned him and said: "You once served the state wholeheartedly in the Western Capital, and when you governed Huazhou you likewise did your part; only now have you reached the third rank.

sentences.zh: 特升授汝此職者，以陝西安撫副使烏古論兗州不遵安撫使達吉不節制，多致敗事。

translations.literal: The reason I have specially promoted and given you this post is that Wugulun Yanzhou, vice commissioner for Shaanxi pacification, did not obey the pacification commissioner Daji's control and often brought about defeats.
translations.idiomatic: I have raised you to this post in particular because Wugulun Yanzhou, vice commissioner for Shaanxi pacification, would not submit to Pacification Commissioner Daji's command and repeatedly caused defeats.

sentences.zh: 今已責罰兗州，命卿副之。

translations.literal: Yanzhou has now been punished; I order you to serve as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou has already been punished; you are to serve as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 宜益務盡心，其或不然，復當別議行之。」

translations.literal: You should strive all the more to devote your heart; if it is otherwise, we shall again consider and act differently."
translations.idiomatic: You must redouble your efforts; if you do not, we shall have to consider other measures."

sentences.zh: 八月，知鳳翔府事，兼本路兵馬都總管，俄爲元帥右都監。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was made administrator of Fengxiang prefecture and concurrently overall commander of military affairs on this circuit; soon after he became right overseer of the marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was appointed administrator of Fengxiang prefecture and overall commander of the circuit's forces, and soon afterward became right overseer of the marshalate.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，調兵拔宋木陡關。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year he mobilized troops and captured the Song pass at Mudou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year he took troops and seized the Song pass at Mudou.

sentences.zh: 五月，夏人於來羌城界河修折橋，以兵守護，賽不遣兵焚之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Xia built a pontoon bridge on the border river at Laicheng and guarded it with troops; Saibu sent troops to burn it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Xia built a pontoon bridge on the border river at Laicheng and posted troops to guard it; Saibu sent forces to burn it down.

sentences.zh: 八月，夏人寇結耶觜川，遣兵擊走之，尋又破其衆于車兒堡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Xia raided Jieyezui River; he sent troops to strike and drive them off, and soon afterward also defeated their force at Che'er Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Xia raided Jieyezui River; he sent troops to repel them and soon afterward routed their force at Che'er Fort as well.

sentences.zh: 興定元年二月，轉簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Xingding, he was transferred to be assistant commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Xingding, he was transferred to be assistant commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 時上以宋歲幣不至，且復侵盜，詔賽不討之。

translations.literal: At the time, because the Song annual payments had not arrived and they had again invaded and raided, the emperor ordered Saibu to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, because the Song annual payments had not arrived and they had again invaded and raided, the emperor ordered Saibu to punish them.

sentences.zh: 四月，與宋人戰於信陽，斬首八千，生擒統制周光，獲馬數千、牛羊五百。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, he fought the Song at Xinyang, cut off eight thousand heads, captured alive the commander Zhou Guang, and took several thousand horses and five hundred cattle and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, he fought the Song at Xinyang, cut off eight thousand heads, captured alive the commander Zhou Guang, and took several thousand horses and five hundred cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 又遇宋人於隴山、七里山等處，前後六戰，斬獲甚衆。

translations.literal: He also encountered the Song at Longshan, Qilishan, and other places; in six battles before and after, he killed and captured very many.
translations.idiomatic: He also encountered the Song at Longshan, Qilishan, and other places; in six battles before and after, he killed and captured very many.

sentences.zh: 尋遣兵渡淮，略中渡店，拔光山、羅山、定城等縣，破光州兩關，斬首萬余，獲馬牛及布，分給將士。

translations.literal: Soon he sent troops across the Huai, raided Zhongdudian, took the counties of Guangshan, Luoshan, Dingcheng, and others, broke through the two passes of Guangzhou, cut off more than ten thousand heads, and captured horses, cattle, and cloth, which he distributed to the officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he sent troops across the Huai, raided Zhongdudian, took the counties of Guangshan, Luoshan, Dingcheng, and others, broke through the two passes of Guangzhou, cut off more than ten thousand heads, and captured horses, cattle, and cloth, which he distributed to the officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 詔賜玉兔鶻一、內府重幣十端。

translations.literal: By edict he was given one jade gyrfalcon and ten bolts of valuable cloth from the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: By edict he was given one jade gyrfalcon and ten bolts of valuable cloth from the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 七月，上章言：「京都天下之根本，其城池宜極高深，今外城雖堅，然週六十餘里，倉猝有警難於拒守。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he submitted a memorial saying: "The capital is the root of all under Heaven; its walls and moat ought to be extremely deep and high. Though the outer wall is now strong, it runs more than sixty li in circuit; if alarm comes suddenly it will be hard to hold.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he memorialized: "The capital is the foundation of the realm; its defenses ought to be as deep and high as possible. The outer wall is strong, but at more than sixty li around it would be hard to hold in a sudden emergency.

sentences.zh: 竊見城中有子城故基，宜於農隙築而新之，爲國家久長之利。

translations.literal: I have observed that within the city there is the old foundation of an inner citadel; it would be fitting to rebuild it anew in the intervals of farming, for the long-term benefit of the state.
translations.idiomatic: I see the old foundations of an inner citadel within the city; it would be well to rebuild it in the farming slack season, for the state's lasting good.

sentences.zh: 及凡河南、陝西州府，皆乞量修。」

translations.literal: I also ask that all prefectures in Henan and Shaanxi be repaired as circumstances allow."
translations.idiomatic: I also ask that all prefectures in Henan and Shaanxi be repaired as circumstances allow."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，破宋人於鐵山及上石店、唐縣。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year he defeated Song forces at Tieshan, Shangshidian, and Tang County.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year he defeated Song forces at Tieshan, Shangshidian, and Tang County.

sentences.zh: 四月，進兼西南等路招討使、西安軍節度使、陝州管內觀察使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was further promoted to concurrently serve as pacification commissioner for the southwestern circuits and others, military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, and surveillance commissioner within Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was further appointed concurrent pacification commissioner for the southwestern circuits and others, military commissioner of the Xi'an Army, and surveillance commissioner of Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 奉詔攻棗陽，宋出兵三萬拒戰，稍誘擊之，宋兵敗走城，薄諸濠，殺及溺死者三千餘人，遂進兵圍之。

translations.literal: By imperial order he attacked Zaoyang; Song sent out thirty thousand troops to resist. He lured and struck them slightly; the Song army was defeated and fled to the city, pressed to the moats, and more than three thousand were killed or drowned; he then advanced to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to attack Zaoyang, he met thirty thousand Song troops in the field, drew them on, and routed them back to the walls; pressed against the moats, more than three thousand were killed or drowned, and he then laid siege to the city.

sentences.zh: 宋騎兵千、步卒萬來援，逆戰復大敗之。

translations.literal: Song sent a thousand cavalry and ten thousand infantry to relieve the city; he met them in battle and again inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: A relief force of a thousand horse and ten thousand foot came up; he met them and routed them again.

sentences.zh: 七月，遷行山東西路兵馬都總管，兼武甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was transferred to acting overall commander of military affairs for the Shandong East and West Circuits, and concurrently military commissioner of the Wuning Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was made acting overall commander of the Shandong East and West Circuits and concurrently military commissioner of the Wuning Army.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，奪宋白石關，殺其守者千餘人，獲鎧仗千計。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year he seized the Song pass at Baishi, killed more than a thousand defenders, and captured on the order of a thousand suits of armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year he took the Song pass at Baishi, killing more than a thousand defenders and capturing roughly a thousand sets of armor and arms.

sentences.zh: 三月，破宋兵於七口倉，又奪宋小鶻倉，獲糧九千石、兵仗三十余萬。

translations.literal: In the third month he defeated Song troops at Qikou Granary, then also seized the Song Little Hu Granary, obtaining nine thousand shi of grain and more than three hundred thousand weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he defeated Song forces at Qikou Granary and seized Little Hu Granary as well, taking nine thousand shi of grain and more than three hundred thousand weapons.

sentences.zh: 是月，復敗宋兵三千于石鶻崖。

translations.literal: That same month he again defeated three thousand Song troops at Shihu Cliff.
translations.idiomatic: That month he also routed three thousand Song troops at Shihu Cliff.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，奉詔出兵河北招降，晉安權府事皇甫珪、正平縣令席永堅率五千餘人來歸，得糧萬石。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, by imperial order he marched into Hebei to accept surrenders; Huangfu Gui, acting administrator of Jin'an, and Zhengping county magistrate Xi Yongjian led more than five thousand men to submit, and he obtained ten thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year he marched into Hebei on orders to accept surrenders; Huangfu Gui, acting administrator of Jin'an, and Zhengping magistrate Xi Yongjian brought more than five thousand men over, yielding ten thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 時河北所在義軍官民堅守堡寨，力戰破敵者衆。

translations.literal: At that time throughout Hebei righteous-army officials and commoners held fast in fortified stockades, and many fought fiercely to break the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout Hebei at that time loyal militia and civilians held fortified stockades, and many fought hard to defeat the enemy.

sentences.zh: 賽不上章言：「此類忠赤可嘉，若不旌酬無以激人心。

translations.literal: Saibu submitted a memorial saying: "Men of this sort, loyal and true, are worthy of praise; if they are not rewarded and honored there is no way to stir men's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Saibu memorialized: "Such loyal devotion deserves recognition; without rewards and honors there is no way to stir men's hearts.

sentences.zh: 乞朝廷量加官賞，萬一敵兵復來，將爭先效用矣。」

translations.literal: I beg the court to add offices and rewards as appropriate; if by chance enemy troops come again, they will vie to serve first."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the court grant offices and rewards as it sees fit; should the enemy return, they will compete to serve first."

sentences.zh: 上覽奏，召樞密官曰：「朕與卿等亦嘗有此議，以不見彼中事勢，故一聽帥臣規畫。

translations.literal: The emperor read the memorial and summoned Marshalate officials, saying: "I too once had this discussion with you, but because I could not see conditions there I left planning entirely to the commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Reading the memorial, the emperor summoned Marshalate officials and said: "I too once discussed this with you, but unable to see conditions on the ground I left planning to the field commanders.

sentences.zh: 今觀此奏，甚稱朕意，其令有司遷賞之。」

translations.literal: Now reading this memorial, it greatly suits my mind; let the relevant offices promote and reward them."
translations.idiomatic: This memorial suits me very well; let the appropriate offices promote and reward them."

sentences.zh: 是年四月，遷樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of that year he was transferred to vice commissioner of the Marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of that year he was made vice commissioner of the Marshalate.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，奉詔引兵救河東，戰屢捷，復晉安、平陽二城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, he received an edict to lead troops to rescue Hedong. He was repeatedly victorious in battle and recovered the two cities of Jin'an and Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year, he received an edict to lead troops to rescue Hedong. He was repeatedly victorious in battle and recovered the two cities of Jin'an and Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 監察御史言其不能檢束士衆，縱之虜略，請正其罪。

translations.literal: Investigating censors said that he had been unable to restrain his officers and men and had let them plunder, and they requested that his crime be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors said that he had been unable to restrain his officers and men and had let them plunder, and they requested that his crime be punished.

sentences.zh: 上以有功，詔勿問。

translations.literal: Because he had merit, the emperor issued an edict not to investigate it.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had merit, the emperor issued an edict not to investigate it.

sentences.zh: 元光二年五月，復河中。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuanguang, he recovered Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuanguang, he recovered Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 六月，詔諭宰臣曰：「樞密副使賽不本皇族，先世偶然脫遺。朕重其舊人，且久勞王家，已命睦親府附於屬籍矣。卿等宜知之。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict instructed the chief ministers, saying, "Vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Saibu was originally of the imperial clan, but in an earlier generation was accidentally lost from the register. I value this old retainer, and he has long labored for the royal house, so I have already ordered the Office for Imperial Kinsmen to attach him to the clan registers. You should know this."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, an edict instructed the chief ministers, saying, "Vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Saibu was originally of the imperial clan, but in an earlier generation was accidentally lost from the register. I value this old retainer, and he has long labored for the royal house, so I have already ordered the Office for Imperial Kinsmen to attach him to the clan registers. You should know this."

sentences.zh: 正大元年五月，拜平章政事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Zhengda, he was appointed manager of governmental affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Zhengda, he was appointed manager of governmental affairs.

sentences.zh: 未幾，轉尚書右丞相。

translations.literal: Before long, he was transferred to be right chancellor of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, he was transferred to be right chancellor of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 雅與參知政事李蹊相得，及蹊以公罪出尹京洛，賽不數薦蹊，比唐魏徵，以故蹊得復相。

translations.literal: He had always been on good terms with Li Xi, participant in determining governmental affairs. When Li Xi was sent out as governor of Jingluo because of an official offense, Saibu repeatedly recommended him, comparing him to Wei Zheng of Tang; for this reason Li Xi was able to return to the chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He had always been on good terms with Li Xi, participant in determining governmental affairs. When Li Xi was sent out as governor of Jingluo because of an official offense, Saibu repeatedly recommended him, comparing him to Wei Zheng of Tang; for this reason Li Xi was able to return to the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三年，宣宗廟成，將禘祭，議配享功臣，論者紛紜。

translations.literal: In the third year, when Xuanzong's temple was completed and the di sacrifice was about to be performed, there was confused debate over which meritorious ministers should be enshrined in accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when Xuanzong's temple was completed and the di sacrifice was about to be performed, there was confused debate over which meritorious ministers should be enshrined in accompaniment.

sentences.zh: 賽不爲大禮使，因言：「丞相福興死王事，七斤謹守河南以迎大駕，功宜配享。」

translations.literal: Saibu was grand ritual commissioner, and therefore said, "Chancellor Fuxing died in the king's affairs, and Qijin carefully held Henan to receive the imperial carriage. Their merit deserves accompanying enshrinement."
translations.idiomatic: Saibu was grand ritual commissioner, and therefore said, "Chancellor Fuxing died in the king's affairs, and Qijin carefully held Henan to receive the imperial carriage. Their merit deserves accompanying enshrinement."

sentences.zh: 議遂定。

translations.literal: The discussion was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: The discussion was then settled.

sentences.zh: 四年，吏部郎中楊居仁上封事，言宰相宜擇人，上語大臣曰：「相府非其人，御史諫官當言，彼吏曹，何與於此。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year Yang Juren, a bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, submitted a sealed memorial arguing that chief ministers must be chosen with care. The emperor told the senior ministers, "If the chief minister's office is wrongly filled, censors and remonstrance officials should speak up. What business is that of the personnel bureau?"
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Yang Juren, a bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, submitted a sealed memorial arguing that chief ministers must be chosen with care. The emperor told the senior ministers, "If the chief minister's office is wrongly filled, censors and remonstrance officials should speak up. What business is that of the personnel bureau?"

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞顏盞世魯素嫉居仁，亦以爲僭，賽不徐進曰：「天下有道，庶人猶得獻言，況在郎官。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Yan Shilu had long resented Juren and also regarded it as presumptuous. Saibu advanced slowly and said: "When all under Heaven is well governed, even commoners may offer words; how much more so a court gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Yan Shilu, who had long resented Juren, likewise called it presumptuous. Saibu stepped forward slowly and said: "When the realm is well governed, even commoners may speak; how much more a court gentleman.

sentences.zh: 陛下有寬弘之德，故不應言者猶言。

translations.literal: Your Majesty possesses a magnanimous virtue, and therefore even those who ought not speak still speak.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's magnanimity is such that even those who ought not speak still do.

sentences.zh: 使其言可用則行之，不可用不必示臣下也。」

translations.literal: If his words can be used, then act on them; if they cannot be used, there is no need to display them to the ministers below."
translations.idiomatic: If his words are useful, act on them; if not, there is no need to parade them before the court."

sentences.zh: 上是之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 居仁字行之，大興人。

translations.literal: Juren, style name Xingzhi, was a man of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Juren, whose style was Xingzhi, was from Daxing.

sentences.zh: 泰和三年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the civil examinations in the third year of Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the civil examinations in Taihe 3 (1203).

sentences.zh: 天興末時北渡，舉家投黃河死。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianxing, when crossing northward, his whole family threw themselves into the Yellow River and died.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tianxing, while crossing north, his entire family drowned themselves in the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 五年，行尚書省於京兆，謂都事商衡曰：「古來宰相必用文人，以其知爲相之道。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, while exercising the Department of State Affairs at Jingzhao, he said to chief clerk Shang Heng: "From antiquity chief ministers have always been men of letters, because they know the way of serving as chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, while acting as Department of State Affairs at Jingzhao, he told chief clerk Shang Heng: "Chief ministers have always been literati, because they understand what the office requires.

sentences.zh: 賽不何所知，使居此位，吾恐他日史官書之，某時以某爲相而國乃亡。」

translations.literal: What does Saibu know, that he should occupy this position? I fear that another day the historians will write that at such a time such a man was made chancellor, and the state then perished."
translations.idiomatic: What does Saibu know, that he should occupy this position? I fear that another day the historians will write that at such a time such a man was made chancellor, and the state then perished."

sentences.zh: 即促衡草表乞致仕。

translations.literal: He at once urged Heng to draft a memorial requesting retirement.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately pressed Heng to draft a memorial requesting retirement.

sentences.zh: 平章政事侯摯樸直無蘊藉，朝廷鄙之，天興元年兵事急，自致仕起爲大司農，未幾復致仕，徐州行尚書省無敢行者，復拜摯平章政事。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Hou Zhi was plain and direct, without reserve; the court despised him. In the first year of Tianxing, when military affairs were urgent, he was raised from retirement to Grand Minister of Agriculture; before long he retired again. No one dared to go exercise the Department at Xuzhou, and Zhi was again appointed participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Hou Zhi was blunt and lacked polish, and the court looked down on him. In Tianxing 1, with war pressing, he was recalled from retirement as Grand Minister of Agriculture; soon he retired again. When no one would take the acting Department post at Xuzhou, Zhi was again made participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 都堂會議，摯以國勢不支，因論數事，曰：「只是更無擘劃。」

translations.literal: At a council in the chief ministers' hall, Zhi, because the state's strength could not hold, discussed several matters and said, "There is simply no further plan to make."
translations.idiomatic: At a council in the chief ministers' hall, Zhi, because the state's strength could not hold, discussed several matters and said, "There is simply no further plan to make."

sentences.zh: 白撒怒曰：「平章出此言，國家何望耶！」

translations.literal: Baisa was angry and said, "When a manager of governmental affairs produces such words, what hope does the state have?"
translations.idiomatic: Baisa was angry and said, "When a manager of governmental affairs produces such words, what hope does the state have?"

sentences.zh: 意在置之不測。

translations.literal: His intent was to place Zhi in unforeseen peril.
translations.idiomatic: His intent was to put Zhi in mortal danger.

sentences.zh: 賽不顧謂白撒曰：「侯相言甚當。」

translations.literal: Saibu turned and said to Baisa, "Minister Hou's words are very apt."
translations.idiomatic: Saibu turned and said to Baisa, "Minister Hou's words are very apt."

sentences.zh: 白撒遂含憤而罷。

translations.literal: Baisa then withdrew, nursing resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Baisa withdrew, swallowing his anger.

sentences.zh: 時大元兵薄汴，白撒策後日講和或出質，必首相當行，力請賽不領省事，拜爲左丞相，尋復致仕。

translations.literal: At that time Great Yuan troops pressed on Bian; Baisa calculated that when peace was later discussed or a hostage was sent out, the chief minister would certainly have to go, and he strongly urged that Saibu head the Department affairs; Saibu was appointed left chief minister, but soon retired again.
translations.idiomatic: With Great Yuan forces closing on Bian, Baisa reckoned that any future peace talks or hostage mission would fall to the chief minister, and pressed hard for Saibu to head Department affairs; Saibu was made left chief minister, but soon retired again.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，哀宗遷歸德，起復爲右丞相，樞密使，兼左副元帥，封壽國公，扈從以行。

translations.literal: That winter Emperor Aizong moved to Guide; Saibu was recalled to serve as right chief minister, marshal commissioner, and concurrently left deputy grand marshal, enfeoffed as Duke of Shou, and accompanied the emperor on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Emperor Aizong moved to Guide; Saibu was recalled as right chief minister, marshal commissioner, and left deputy grand marshal, enfeoffed Duke of Shou, and escorted the court on the move.

sentences.zh: 河北兵潰，從至歸德，又請致仕。

translations.literal: The Hebei army collapsed; he followed to Guide and again requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: After the Hebei army collapsed he followed to Guide and again asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，復詔行尚書省事於徐州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year he was again ordered to exercise Department affairs at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year he was again ordered to act as Department of State Affairs at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 既至，以州乏糧，遣郎中王萬慶會徐、宿、靈璧兵取源州，令元帥郭恩統之。

translations.literal: Once he arrived, because the prefecture lacked grain, he sent bureau director Wang Wanqing to join the troops of Xu, Su, and Lingbi to take Yuanzhou, and ordered Marshal Guo En to command them.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival, finding the prefecture short of grain, he sent bureau director Wang Wanqing to combine forces from Xu, Su, and Lingbi to take Yuanzhou, placing Marshal Guo En in command.

sentences.zh: 九月，恩至源州城下，敗績而還。

translations.literal: In the ninth month En reached below Yuanzhou city, suffered defeat, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month En reached Yuanzhou and was defeated, returning in rout.

sentences.zh: 再命卓翼攻豐縣，破之。

translations.literal: He again ordered Zhuo Yi to attack Feng County and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered Zhuo Yi to attack Feng County and took it.

sentences.zh: 初，郭恩以敗爲恥，托疾不行，乃密與河北諸叛將郭野驢輩謀歸國用安，執元帥商瑀父子、元帥左都監紇石烈善住，並殺之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Guo En, shamed by defeat, pleaded illness and would not go; he then secretly with the Hebei rebel generals Guo Yelü and others plotted to submit to Guo Yong'an, seized Marshal Shang Yu and his son, and Marshalate Left Overseer Heshenlie Shanzhu, and killed them all.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Guo En, shamed by defeat, feigned illness and refused to march; he then secretly plotted with Hebei rebel generals such as Guo Yelü to join Guo Yong'an, seized Marshal Shang Yu and his son and Marshalate Left Overseer Heshenlie Shanzhu, and killed them all.

sentences.zh: 又逐都尉斡轉留奴、泥龐古桓端、蒲察世謀、元帥右都監李居仁、員外郎常忠。

translations.literal: He also drove out commandant Wozhuan Liunu, Nipanggu Huanduan, Pucha Shimou, Marshalate Right Overseer Li Juren, and bureau aide Chang Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: He also drove out Commandant Wozhuan Liunu, Nipanggu Huanduan, Pucha Shimou, Marshalate Right Overseer Li Juren, and bureau aide Chang Zhong.

sentences.zh: 自是，防城與守門者皆河北義軍，出入自恣。

translations.literal: From then on those who defended the walls and guarded the gates were all Hebei righteous-army troops, coming and going as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter wall defense and gate guards were all Hebei militia, coming and going as they pleased.

sentences.zh: 賽不先病疽，久不視事，重爲賊黨所制，束手聽命而已。

translations.literal: Saibu had earlier fallen ill with an abscess and for a long time did not attend to affairs; he was heavily controlled by the rebel faction and could only fold his hands and obey.
translations.idiomatic: Saibu had long been ill with an abscess and had ceased to govern; now thoroughly controlled by the rebels, he could only fold his hands and obey.

sentences.zh: 初，源、徐交攻，郭野驢者每辭疾不行，賽不遂授野驢徐州節度副使，兼防城都總領，實羈之也。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Yuan and Xu were attacking each other, Guo Yelü each time pleaded illness and would not go; Saibu thereupon appointed Yelü deputy military commissioner of Xuzhou and concurrently overall leader of wall defense—in truth to restrain him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while Yuan and Xu were at war, Guo Yelü repeatedly pleaded illness and refused to march; Saibu then made him deputy military commissioner of Xuzhou and overall leader of wall defense, in effect to keep him on a leash.

sentences.zh: 野驢既見徐州空虛，乃約源州叛將麻琮內外相應。

translations.literal: Once Yelü saw that Xuzhou was empty, he arranged with the Yuanzhou rebel general Ma Cong for coordinated action inside and out.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Xuzhou undefended, Yelü arranged with Yuanzhou rebel Ma Cong for a coordinated strike from within and without.

sentences.zh: 十月甲申，詰旦，襲破徐州。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the tenth month, at daybreak, they stormed and took Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the tenth month, at dawn, they stormed and seized Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 時蔡已被圍，徐州將士以朝命阻絕，且逼大兵，議出降。

translations.literal: At that time Cai was already besieged; the officers and soldiers of Xuzhou, because court orders were cut off and great enemy forces pressed close, discussed surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Cai was already besieged; Xuzhou's officers and men, cut off from court orders and pressed by the main enemy force, debated surrender.

sentences.zh: 賽不弗從，恐被執，至是投河求死，流三十余步不沒，軍士援出之。

translations.literal: Saibu would not agree, fearing he would be seized; at this point he threw himself into the river seeking death, but after drifting more than thirty paces he did not sink, and soldiers pulled him out.
translations.idiomatic: Saibu refused, fearing capture; he now threw himself into the river to die, but drifted more than thirty paces without sinking and was pulled out by soldiers.

sentences.zh: 又五日，自縊於州第。

translations.literal: Five days later he hanged himself in the prefectural residence.
translations.idiomatic: Five days later he hanged himself in the prefectural mansion.

sentences.zh: 麻琮乃遣人以州降大元。

translations.literal: Ma Cong then sent men to surrender the prefecture to Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Cong then sent envoys to surrender the prefecture to the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 子按春，正大中充護衛，坐與宗室女奸，杖一百收系。

translations.literal: His son An Chun, in the Zhengda era served as an imperial guard; for illicit relations with a clanswoman of the imperial house he was beaten one hundred strokes and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: His son An Chun served as an imperial guard in the Zhengda era; for an affair with an imperial clanswoman he received a hundred strokes and was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 居許州，大兵至許，按春開南門以降。

translations.literal: He resided at Xuzhou; when the great army reached Xu, An Chun opened the south gate to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Living at Xuzhou, when the main army reached the city An Chun opened the south gate and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 從攻京師，曹王出質，朝臣及近衛有從出者，按春極口大罵，以至指斥。

translations.literal: He followed in the attack on the capital; when the Prince of Cao was sent out as hostage and court ministers and close guards went out with him, An Chun cursed them at the top of his voice, even to the point of pointing and reviling.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the assault on the capital; when the Prince of Cao was sent out as a hostage and courtiers and guards went with him, An Chun railed at them loudly, even pointing and reviling them.

sentences.zh: 是冬，復自北中逃回，詔令押入省，問事情，按春隨近侍登階作揮涕之狀。

translations.literal: That winter he again fled back from the northern center; an edict ordered him escorted into the Department to be questioned. An Chun followed the close attendants up the steps, making a show of wiping away tears.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he escaped back from the north; ordered escorted into the Department for questioning, An Chun followed the attendants up the steps, feigning tears.

sentences.zh: 詔問丞相云：「按春自北中來，丞相好與問彼中息耗。」

translations.literal: An edict asked the chancellor, "An Chun has come from the northern center; Chancellor, you should ask him about news from there."
translations.idiomatic: An edict asked the chancellor, "An Chun has come from the northern center; Chancellor, you should ask him about news from there."

sentences.zh: 賽不附奏曰：「老臣不幸生此賊，事至今日，恨不手刃之，忍與對面語乎！」

translations.literal: Saibu added in a memorial, "This old minister was unfortunate enough to produce this traitor. Now that affairs have come to this, I regret not killing him with my own hand. How could I bear to speak with him face to face?"
translations.idiomatic: Saibu added in a memorial, "This old minister was unfortunate enough to produce this traitor. Now that affairs have come to this, I regret not killing him with my own hand. How could I bear to speak with him face to face?"

sentences.zh: 十二月，車駕東狩，留後二相下開封，擒捕斬之獄中。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the imperial carriage made the eastern hunt; the two chief ministers left behind went down to Kaifeng, seized him, and executed him in prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, as the court made its eastern move, the two chief ministers left behind went to Kaifeng, seized him, and executed him in prison.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：賽不臨陣對壘既有將略，洎秉鈞衡，觀其救解楊居仁、侯摯等言，殊有相度，按春之事尤有古人之風焉。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Saibu, when facing the enemy across the battle lines, already had generalship; once he held the scales of state, observing his words in saving Yang Juren and Hou Zhi and others, he had no small measure of a chief minister; in the matter of An Chun he especially had the spirit of the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium reads: In the field Saibu already showed generalship; once he held the reins of state, his defense of Yang Juren and Hou Zhi reveals no small ministerial judgment; his handling of An Chun especially recalls the ancients.

sentences.zh: 晚以老病，受制叛臣，致修匹夫匹婦之節，此猶大廈將傾，非一木之所能支也，悲夫！

translations.literal: In his late years, worn by age and illness, controlled by rebel ministers, he came to observe the integrity of common man and woman—yet this was like a great hall about to collapse, not something a single timber could support. How sad!
translations.idiomatic: In old age, ill and in rebel hands, he still upheld the integrity of an ordinary man and woman—but when the great hall is falling, one beam cannot hold it up. Alas!

sentences.zh: 完顏白撒

translations.literal: Wanyan Baisa
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Baisa

sentences.zh: 內族白撒，名承裔，末帝承麟之兄也，系出世祖諸孫。

translations.literal: Baisa of the inner clan, personal name Chengyi, was the elder brother of the last emperor Chenglong; his line issued from the grandsons of the founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Baisa of the imperial clan, personal name Chengyi, was elder brother to the last emperor Chenglong and descended from the founder's grandsons.

sentences.zh: 自幼爲奉御。

translations.literal: From youth he served as a palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he served as a palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 貞祐間，累官知臨洮府事、兼本路兵馬都總管。

translations.literal: During Zhenyou he rose through offices to administer Linzhou prefecture and concurrently serve as overall commander of military affairs on this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenyou he rose to administer Linzhou prefecture and concurrently command the circuit's forces.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，爲元帥左都監，行帥府事於鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding he became left overseer of the marshalate and exercised marshal headquarters affairs at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding 1 (1217) he became left overseer of the marshalate and acted as marshal headquarters at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 是年，詔陝西行省伐宋，白撒出鞏州鹽川，遇宋兵於皁郊堡，敗之。

translations.literal: That year an edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to campaign against Song; Baisa marched out from Yanchuan in Gongzhou, met Song troops at Zaojiao Fort, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to invade Song; Baisa marched from Yanchuan in Gongzhou, met Song forces at Zaojiao Fort, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 又遇宋兵于天水軍，掩擊，宋兵大潰。

translations.literal: He again met Song troops at Tianshui Army, struck by surprise, and the Song army was utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: He met Song forces again at Tianshui Army, struck by surprise, and routed them completely.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，復敗宋兵，至雞公山，遂拔西和州，毀其諸隘營屯。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year he again defeated Song troops, reached Jigong Mountain, then took Xihe prefecture and destroyed its passes, stockades, and camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year he defeated Song forces again, reached Jigong Mountain, took Xihe prefecture, and destroyed its passes, stockades, and camps.

sentences.zh: 遣合紮都統完顏習涅阿不率軍趨成州，宋帥羅參政、統制李大亨焚廬舍棄城遁，留千餘人城守，督兵赴之，逐克焉，獲糧七萬斛，錢數千萬。

translations.literal: He sent Combined Regiment overall commander Wanyan Xinieabu with an army toward Chengzhou; the Song commander Luo the Participation Councillor and controller Li Daheng burned their lodges, abandoned the city, and fled, leaving more than a thousand to hold the walls. He urged his troops forward, pursued, and took it, obtaining seventy thousand hu of grain and tens of millions in cash.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Combined Regiment commander Wanyan Xinieabu toward Chengzhou; Song commander Luo the Participation Councillor and Controller Li Daheng burned their quarters, abandoned the city, and fled, leaving a thousand men to hold the walls. He pressed forward, took the city in pursuit, and seized seventy thousand hu of grain and tens of millions in cash.

sentences.zh: 河池縣守將楊九鼎亦焚縣舍走保清野原。

translations.literal: Yang Jiuding, defending general of Hechi County, also burned the county offices and fled to hold Qingye Plain.
translations.idiomatic: Hechi defender Yang Jiuding likewise burned the county offices and withdrew to Qingye Plain.

sentences.zh: 統制高千據黑谷關甚固，遣兵襲之，千遁去，獲糧二萬斛，器械稱是，因夷其險而還。

translations.literal: Controller Gao Qian held Heigu Pass very firmly; Baisa sent troops to strike it, Qian fled, and he obtained twenty thousand hu of grain and a full complement of weapons; he then leveled its defenses and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Controller Gao Qian held Heigu Pass firmly; Baisa sent troops against it, Qian fled, and he took twenty thousand hu of grain and ample arms before leveling the pass's defenses and returning.

sentences.zh: 三年，破虎頭關，敗宋兵於七盤子、雞冠關。

translations.literal: In the third year he broke Hutou Pass and defeated Song troops at Qipanzi and Jiguan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he took Hutou Pass and defeated Song forces at Qipanzi and Jiguan Pass.

sentences.zh: 褒城縣官民自焚城宇遁，因取其城。

translations.literal: The officials and people of Baocheng County burned their city buildings and fled; he thereupon took their city.
translations.idiomatic: Baocheng's officials and people burned the city and fled, and he took the town.

sentences.zh: 興元府提刑兼知府事趙希昔聞兵將至，率官民遁，於是白撒遂取興元，以駐兵焉。

translations.literal: Zhao Xixi, intendant for criminal cases and concurrent prefect of Xingyuan, hearing that troops were about to arrive, led officials and people in flight; Baisa thereupon took Xingyuan and stationed troops there.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xixi, Xingyuan's intendant for criminal cases and concurrent prefect, fled with officials and people on word that troops were coming; Baisa then took Xingyuan and encamped there.

sentences.zh: 命提控張秀華馳視洋州，官民亦遁，又取其城。

translations.literal: He ordered controller Zhang Xiuhua to ride quickly to inspect Yangzhou; officials and people also fled, and he again took that city.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Controller Zhang Xiuhua to reconnoiter Yangzhou; officials and people fled there too, and he took that city as well.

sentences.zh: 尋聞漢江之南三十里，宋兵二千據山而陣，遣提控唐括移失不擊走之。

translations.literal: Soon he heard that thirty li south of the Han River two thousand Song troops had taken the mountains in formation; he sent controller Tangguo Yishibu to strike and drive them off.
translations.idiomatic: He soon learned that two thousand Song troops had formed on the hills thirty li south of the Han; he sent Controller Tangguo Yishibu to drive them off.

sentences.zh: 行省以捷聞，宣宗大悅，進白撒官一階。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat reported the victory; Emperor Xuanzong was greatly pleased and advanced Baisa's office one rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat reported victory; Emperor Xuanzong was delighted and raised Baisa's rank one step.

sentences.zh: 時朝議以蘭州當西夏之沖，久爲敵據，將遣白撒復之，白撒奏曰：「臣近入宋境，略河池，下鳳州，破興元，抵洋州而還。

translations.literal: At that time the court debated that Lanzhou lay on the Xia frontier and had long been held by the enemy; they were about to send Baisa to recover it. Baisa memorialized: "Your servant has recently entered Song territory, overrun Hechi, taken Fengzhou, broken Xingyuan, reached Yangzhou, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The court then debated recovering Lanzhou, on the Xia frontier and long in enemy hands, by sending Baisa. He memorialized: "I have just invaded Song territory, overrun Hechi, taken Fengzhou, broken Xingyuan, reached Yangzhou, and returned.

sentences.zh: 經涉險阻數千里，士馬疲弊，未得少休，而欲重爲是舉，甚非計也，不若息兵養士以備。」

translations.literal: We have passed through thousands of li of difficult country; men and horses are exhausted and have not yet had even a little rest. To wish to undertake this again is very poor planning. It would be better to rest the troops and nourish the soldiers in preparation."
translations.idiomatic: We have passed through thousands of li of difficult country; men and horses are exhausted and have not yet had even a little rest. To wish to undertake this again is very poor planning. It would be better to rest the troops and nourish the soldiers in preparation."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，權參知政事，行省事於平涼。

translations.literal: Before long he was acting participation councillor, exercising secretariat affairs at Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was acting participation councillor, handling secretariat affairs at Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 四年，上言：「宋境山州宕昌東上拶一帶蕃族，昔嘗歸附，分處德順、鎮戎之間。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he submitted a memorial: "On the Song frontier, the tribal peoples along Dangchang and the eastern Shangza strip once submitted and were settled between Deshun and Zhenrong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he memorialized: "Along the Song frontier, the tribes of Dangchang and the eastern Shangza strip once submitted and were settled between Deshun and Zhenrong.

sentences.zh: 其後有司不能存撫，相繼亡去。

translations.literal: Afterward the offices could not preserve and comfort them, and they left one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Later the authorities failed to keep them loyal, and they drifted away one by one.

sentences.zh: 近聞復有歸心，然不招之亦無由自至。

translations.literal: I have recently heard that they again incline to return, yet if they are not summoned they have no means to come of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: I hear they are willing to return, but without invitation they cannot come on their own.

sentences.zh: 誠得其衆，可以助兵，甯謐一方。

translations.literal: If we truly gain their masses, they can aid our troops and bring quiet to the region.
translations.idiomatic: If we win them over, they can reinforce our armies and pacify the region.

sentences.zh: 臣以同知通遠軍節度使事烏古論長壽及通遠軍節度副使溫敦永昌皆本蕃屬，且久鎮邊鄙，深得彼心，已命遣人招之。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that Wugulun Changshou, associate military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army, and Wenden Yongchang, deputy military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army, are both of native tribal stock and have long governed the frontier, deeply knowing their hearts; I have already ordered men sent to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Changshou, associate commissioner of the Tongyuan Army, and Wenden Yongchang, its deputy commissioner, are both tribal natives who have long governed the frontier and know these peoples well; I have already sent envoys to summon them.

sentences.zh: 其所遣及諸來歸者，皆當甄獎，請預定賞格以待之。」

translations.literal: Those whom they send and all those who come to submit should be distinguished and rewarded. I ask that reward scales be fixed in advance to await them."
translations.idiomatic: Those whom they send and all those who come to submit should be distinguished and rewarded. I ask that reward scales be fixed in advance to await them."

sentences.zh: 上是其言。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 是年，夏兵三萬由高峰嶺入寇定西州，環城爲柵，白撒遣刺史愛申阿失剌與行軍提控烏古論長壽、溫敦永昌出戰，大敗之，斬首千余，獲馬仗甚衆。

translations.literal: That year thirty thousand Xia troops entered by Gaofeng Ridge to raid Dingxi prefecture and ringed the city with palisades. Baisa sent prefect Aishen Asila together with campaign controller Wugulun Changshou and Wenden Yongchang to give battle, inflicted a great defeat, beheaded more than a thousand, and captured a great quantity of horses and arms.
translations.idiomatic: That year thirty thousand Xia troops entered by Gaofeng Ridge against Dingxi and encircled the city with palisades. Baisa sent Prefect Aishen Asila with Campaign Controllers Wugulun Changshou and Wenden Yongchang; they routed the enemy, took more than a thousand heads, and seized many horses and weapons.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，白撒言：「近詔臣遣官諭諸蕃族以討西夏，臣即令臨洮路總管女奚烈古里間計約喬家丙令族首領以諭余族。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year Baisa said: "Recently an edict ordered your servant to send officials to instruct the various tribal peoples to attack Western Xia. Your servant at once ordered Linzhou Circuit overseer Nüxilie Gulijian to arrange with Qiao Jiabing that tribal chiefs instruct the remaining clans.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fifth year Baisa reported: "I was recently ordered to send officials to rally the tribes against Western Xia. I have had Linzhou overseer Nüxilie Gulijian work with Qiao Jiabing so tribal chiefs can summon the rest.

sentences.zh: 又別遣權左右司都事趙梅委差官遙授合河縣尉劉貞同往撫諭。

translations.literal: I also separately sent acting director of the Left and Right Offices Zhao Mei, commissioning a traveling official and remotely appointing Hehe county lieutenant Liu Zhen to go together to pacify and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: I also sent Acting Director Zhao Mei, with a traveling commissioner and remotely appointed Hehe county lieutenant Liu Zhen, to reassure them jointly.

sentences.zh: 未幾，梅、貞報溪哥城等處諸族，與先降族共願助兵七萬八千余人，本國蕃族願助兵九千，若更以官軍繼爲聲援，勝夏必矣。

translations.literal: Before long Mei and Zhen reported that the clans around Xige City and elsewhere, together with clans that had earlier submitted, were all willing to aid with more than seventy-eight thousand troops; native tribal peoples of our state were willing to aid with nine thousand. If regular troops follow as a supporting force, victory over Xia is certain.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Mei and Zhen reported that clans around Xige City and elsewhere, with those already submitted, offered more than seventy-eight thousand men; our own tribes offered nine thousand more. With regular troops as backing, Xia can surely be defeated.

sentences.zh: 臣已令古里間將鞏州兵三萬，宜更擇勇略之臣副之。

translations.literal: Your servant has already ordered Gulijian to lead thirty thousand troops from Gongzhou; a brave and resourceful minister ought to be chosen to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered Gulijian to lead thirty thousand Gongzhou troops; a capable minister should be sent to assist him.

sentences.zh: 梅、貞等既悉事勢，當假以軍前之職。

translations.literal: Since Mei, Zhen, and the others already understand the situation thoroughly, they should be given field commands.
translations.idiomatic: Mei, Zhen, and the others know the situation well and should be given field commands.

sentences.zh: 蕃僧納林心波亦招誘有功，乞遷官授職以獎勵之。」

translations.literal: The Tibetan monk Nalin Xinbo has also rendered service in recruiting and inducing them. I ask that he be promoted and appointed to office, in order to encourage him."
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan monk Nalin Xinbo has also rendered service in recruiting and inducing them. I ask that he be promoted and appointed to office, in order to encourage him."

sentences.zh: 上皆從其請。

translations.literal: The emperor assented to all his requests.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all his requests.

sentences.zh: 元光元年二月，行省上言：「近與延安元帥完顏合達、納合買住議：河北郡縣俱已殘毀，陝西、河南亦經抄掠。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yuanguang the Branch Secretariat submitted a memorial: "Recently, together with Yan'an Marshal Wanyan Heda and Naha Maizhu, we discussed: the commanderies and counties of Hebei are all ruined, and Shaanxi and Henan have also been plundered.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Yuanguang the Branch Secretariat memorialized: "I have lately discussed with Yan'an Marshal Wanyan Heda and Naha Maizhu: Hebei's commanderies and counties lie in ruins, and Shaanxi and Henan have been plundered as well.

sentences.zh: 比者西北二敵並攻鄜延，城邑隨陷，惟延安孤墉僅得保全。

translations.literal: Recently the two enemies of the northwest attacked Fuyan together; cities and towns fell in turn, and only the lone wall of Yan'an barely escaped destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the two northwestern enemies attacked Fuyan together; town after town fell, and only Yan'an's lone walls barely held.

sentences.zh: 若今秋復至，必長驅而深入，雖京兆、鳳翔、慶陽、平涼已各益軍，而率皆步卒，且相去闊遠，卒難應援，倘關中諸鎮不支，則河南亦不安矣。

translations.literal: If they come again this autumn they will surely drive deep in a long advance. Though Jingzhao, Fengxiang, Qingyang, and Pingliang have each increased their armies, they are mostly infantry, and the distances between them are vast, so sudden mutual relief is hard; if the garrisons of Guanzhong cannot hold, Henan too will be unsafe.
translations.idiomatic: If they return this autumn they will drive deep inland. Jingzhao, Fengxiang, Qingyang, and Pingliang have each reinforced, but mostly with infantry spread far apart, so mutual relief will be difficult; if Guanzhong's garrisons fail, Henan will be unsafe as well.

sentences.zh: 今二敵遠去，西北少休，宜乘此隙徑取蜀、漢、實國家基業萬全之計。」

translations.literal: Now that the two enemies have gone far away and the northwest has a little respite, we should take this opening to go directly for Shu and Han. This is the state's absolutely secure plan for its foundation."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the two enemies have gone far away and the northwest has a little respite, we should take this opening to go directly for Shu and Han. This is the state's absolutely secure plan for its foundation."

sentences.zh: 詔樞密議之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Marshalate to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Marshalate to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 先是，夏兵數十萬分寇龕穀、鄜延、大通諸城，上召白撒等授以方略，命發兵襲其浮橋，遂趨西涼。

translations.literal: Earlier, several hundred thousand Xia troops raided in separate columns the cities of Kan'gu, Fuyan, and Datong. The emperor summoned Baisa and others, gave them strategy, and ordered troops sent to strike their pontoon bridge and then press toward Xiliang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier several hundred thousand Xia troops had raided Kan'gu, Fuyan, Datong, and other cities. The emperor summoned Baisa and others, gave them their plan, and ordered troops to strike the enemy pontoon bridge and advance on Xiliang.

sentences.zh: 別遣將取大通城，出溪哥路，略夏地。

translations.literal: Another detachment of generals was sent to take Datong city, marching out by the Xige route to overrun Xia territory.
translations.idiomatic: Other generals were sent to take Datong by the Xige route and overrun Xia territory.

sentences.zh: 白撒徐出鎮戎，合達出環州，以報三道之役。

translations.literal: Baisa advanced slowly out of Zhenrong, Heda out of Huanzhou, to answer the campaign on three routes.
translations.idiomatic: Baisa marched out of Zhenrong and Heda out of Huanzhou to meet the three-pronged campaign.

sentences.zh: 白撒馳至臨洮，遣總管女奚烈古里間、積石州刺史徒單牙武各攝帥職，率兵西入，遇夏兵千余于踏南寺，擊走之。

translations.literal: Baisa galloped to Linzhou, sent overseer Nüxilie Gulijian and Jishi prefecture prefect Tushan Yawu each to act as commander, and led troops west; at Tanan Monastery they met more than a thousand Xia troops and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Baisa raced to Linzhou and sent Overseer Nüxilie Gulijian and Jishi Prefect Tushan Yawu, each acting as commander, west with the army; at Tanan Monastery they met a thousand Xia troops and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 夏人據大通城，因圍之，分兵奪其橋，與守兵七千人戰，大敗之，幾殺其半，入河死者不可計，餘兵焚其橋西遁。

translations.literal: The Xia held Datong city, so he besieged it, detached troops to seize their bridge, and fought seven thousand defenders, inflicting a great defeat, killing nearly half; those who drowned in the river were beyond counting, and the rest burned their bridge and fled west.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia held Datong, which he besieged; detaching troops to seize their bridge, he fought seven thousand defenders, killing nearly half; countless drowned in the river, and the rest burned the bridge and fled west.

sentences.zh: 乃還軍攻大通，克之，斬首三千，因招來諸寺族被脅僧俗人，皆按堵如故。

translations.literal: He then turned the army to attack Datong, took it, and beheaded three thousand; he thereby summoned back monks and laypeople of the various temple clans who had been coerced, and all remained settled as before.
translations.idiomatic: He then turned back, took Datong, and beheaded three thousand; monks and laypeople of the temple clans who had been coerced were brought back, and all remained at peace.

sentences.zh: 以河梁既焚，塞外地寒少草，師遂還。

translations.literal: Because the river bridge had been burned and beyond the passes the land was cold with little grass, the army then returned.
translations.idiomatic: With the bridge burned and the frontier cold and short of forage, the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十二月，行省言：「近有人自北來者，稱國王木華里悉兵沿渭而西，謀攻鳳翔，鳳翔既下乃圖京兆，京兆卒不可得，留兵守之，至春蹂踐二麥以困我。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Branch Secretariat said: "Recently someone came from the north reporting that King Muqali was gathering all his troops along the Wei westward, planning to attack Fengxiang; once Fengxiang fell he would aim at Jingzhao. Jingzhao could not be taken at once, so he would leave troops to hold it and in spring trample the twin wheat crops to wear us down.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Branch Secretariat reported: "A man recently arrived from the north saying King Muqali was massing troops along the Wei westward to attack Fengxiang; once Fengxiang fell he would target Jingzhao. Unable to take Jingzhao at once, he would garrison it and in spring trample the wheat to starve us.

sentences.zh: 未幾，大兵果圍鳳翔，帥府遣人告急。

translations.literal: Before long the great army indeed besieged Fengxiang, and the marshal headquarters sent men in urgent appeal.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the main army did besiege Fengxiang, and headquarters sent urgent appeals for help.

sentences.zh: 臣以爲二鎮脣齒也，鳳翔蹉跌，則京兆必危，而陝右大震矣。

translations.literal: Your servant considers the two garrisons lip and teeth: if Fengxiang stumbled, Jingzhao would surely be in peril and the whole of western Shaanxi would be shaken.
translations.idiomatic: The two garrisons are lip and teeth: if Fengxiang fell, Jingzhao would be in peril and all western Shaanxi would shake.

sentences.zh: 然平川廣野實騎兵馳騁之地，未可與之爭鋒。

translations.literal: Yet open plains and broad fields are truly ground for cavalry to gallop; we cannot contend with them head-on.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the open plains are cavalry country; we cannot meet them head-on in the field.

sentences.zh: 已遣提控羅桓將兵二千，循南山而進，伺隙攻其柵壘，以紓城圍。

translations.literal: I have already sent controller Luo Huan with two thousand troops to advance along the southern mountains, watch for openings to attack their stockades and palisades, and ease the siege.
translations.idiomatic: I have sent Controller Luo Huan with two thousand men along the southern hills to strike their camps when chance offers and relieve the siege.

sentences.zh: 更乞發河南步騎以備潼關。」

translations.literal: I further request that infantry and cavalry from Henan be dispatched to prepare the defense of Tong Pass."
translations.idiomatic: I further request that infantry and cavalry from Henan be dispatched to prepare the defense of Tong Pass."

sentences.zh: 詔付尚書省樞密院議之。

translations.literal: An edict referred the matter to the Department of State Affairs and the Marshalate for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor referred the matter to the Department of State Affairs and the Marshalate.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，哀宗即位，邊事益急。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year, Emperor Aizong ascended the throne, and frontier affairs became still more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year, Emperor Aizong ascended the throne, and frontier affairs became still more urgent.

sentences.zh: 正大五年八月，召白撒還朝，拜尚書右丞，未幾，拜平章政事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year of Zhengda, Baisa was summoned back to court and appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs. Before long, he was appointed manager of governmental affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year of Zhengda, Baisa was summoned back to court and appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs. Before long, he was appointed manager of governmental affairs.

sentences.zh: 白撒居西垂幾十年，當宋、夏之交，雖頗立微效，皆出諸將之力。

translations.literal: Baisa had lived on the western frontier for several decades, at the junction with Song and Xia. Although he had established some small achievements, they all came from the efforts of his generals.
translations.idiomatic: Baisa had lived on the western frontier for several decades, at the junction with Song and Xia. Although he had established some small achievements, they all came from the efforts of his generals.

sentences.zh: 然本恇怯無能，徒以儀體爲事，性愎貪鄙，及入爲相，專愎尤甚。

translations.literal: Yet he was fundamentally timid, cowardly, and incapable; he merely made a matter of ceremony and appearance, and his nature was obstinate, greedy, and base. After he entered the chancellery, his arbitrary obstinacy became especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was fundamentally timid, cowardly, and incapable; he merely made a matter of ceremony and appearance, and his nature was obstinate, greedy, and base. After he entered the chancellery, his arbitrary obstinacy became especially severe.

sentences.zh: 嘗惡堂食不適口，每以家膳自隨，國家顛覆，初不恤也。

translations.literal: He once disliked the official meals because they did not suit his taste, and always brought food from his own household with him. As the state was overturning, he showed no concern at all.
translations.idiomatic: He once disliked the official meals because they did not suit his taste, and always brought food from his own household with him. As the state was overturning, he showed no concern at all.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，諸軍敗績於三峰山。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year the armies were defeated at Sanfeng Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year the armies were routed at Sanfeng Mountain.

sentences.zh: 大兵與白坡兵合，長驅趨汴。

translations.literal: The great army joined with the Baipo troops and drove at full speed toward Bian.
translations.idiomatic: The main army joined Baipo forces and marched straight on Bian.

sentences.zh: 令史楊居仁請乘其遠至擊之，白撒不從，且陰怒之。

translations.literal: Clerk Yang Juren asked to strike them while they had come from far away; Baisa would not agree and secretly harbored anger toward him.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Yang Juren urged striking them while they were still weary from the march; Baisa refused and secretly resented him.

sentences.zh: 遂遣完顏麻斤出、邵公茂等部民萬人，開短堤，決河水，以固京城。

translations.literal: He then sent Wanyan Majinchu, Shao Gongmao, and others to mobilize ten thousand civilians, open a short dike, and breach the river to strengthen the capital's defenses.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Wanyan Majinchu, Shao Gongmao, and others to levy ten thousand civilians, cut a short dike, and flood the river to strengthen the capital.

sentences.zh: 功未畢而騎兵奄至，麻斤出等皆被害，丁壯無二三百人得反者。

translations.literal: Before the work was finished cavalry suddenly arrived; Majinchu and the others were all killed, and of the able-bodied men not even two or three hundred returned.
translations.idiomatic: Before the work was done cavalry swept in; Majinchu and the rest were killed, and fewer than two or three hundred able-bodied men escaped.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，棄衛州，運守具入京。

translations.literal: On renchen they abandoned Weizhou and transported the siege equipment into the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day they abandoned Weizhou and brought the siege equipment to the capital.

sentences.zh: 初，大兵破衛州，宣宗南遷，移州治於宜村渡，築新城于河北岸，去河不數步，惟北面受敵，而以石包之，歲屯重兵於此，大兵屢至不能近。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the great army broke Weizhou, Emperor Xuanzong moved south and shifted the prefectural seat to Yicun Ford, building a new city on the north bank of the river only a few paces from the water, exposed to the enemy only on the north and encased in stone; each year heavy troops were stationed here, and though the great army came repeatedly it could not approach.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the main army took Weizhou, Emperor Xuanzong moved south and relocated the seat to Yicun Ford, building a new city on the north bank a few paces from the river, exposed only on the north and faced with stone; heavy troops were posted there yearly, and repeated enemy attacks could not reach it.

sentences.zh: 至是，棄之，隨爲大兵所據。

translations.literal: At this point they abandoned it, and it was promptly occupied by the great army.
translations.idiomatic: Now they abandoned it, and the main army promptly occupied it.

sentences.zh: 甲午，修京城樓櫓。

translations.literal: On jiawu they repaired the capital's towers and parapets.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day they repaired the capital's towers and parapets.

sentences.zh: 初，宣宗以京城闊遠難守，詔高琪築裏城，公私力盡僅乃得成。

translations.literal: Earlier, because the capital was broad and far-flung and hard to defend, Emperor Xuanzong ordered Gao Qi to build an inner city; public and private strength was exhausted before it was barely completed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Emperor Xuanzong, finding the capital too sprawling to defend, ordered Gao Qi to build an inner city; public and private resources were exhausted before it was barely finished.

sentences.zh: 至是，議所守。

translations.literal: At this point they debated which city to hold.
translations.idiomatic: Now they debated which walls to hold.

sentences.zh: 朝臣有言裏城決不可守，外城決不可棄。

translations.literal: Court ministers said the inner city absolutely could not be held and the outer city absolutely could not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers argued that the inner city could not be held and the outer city must not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 大兵先得外城，糧盡救絕，走一人不出。

translations.literal: If the great army first took the outer city, grain would be exhausted and relief cut off, and not a single fugitive would get out.
translations.idiomatic: If the enemy took the outer city first, grain would run out and relief would fail—not one man could escape.

sentences.zh: 裏城或不測可用，於是決計守外城。

translations.literal: The inner city might unexpectedly still be usable; they therefore resolved to defend the outer city.
translations.idiomatic: The inner city might still serve in an emergency; they resolved to defend the outer walls.

sentences.zh: 時在城諸軍不滿四萬，京城周百二十里，人守一乳口尚不能遍，故議避遷之民充軍。

translations.literal: At the time the armies in the city numbered fewer than forty thousand; the capital ran a circuit of a hundred and twenty li, and even one man per crenel could not cover it all, so they debated drafting refugees and migrants into the army.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison then numbered fewer than forty thousand; the capital's circuit was a hundred and twenty li, and even one man per crenel would not suffice, so they debated drafting refugees into service.

sentences.zh: 又召在京軍官于上清宮，平日防城得功者如內族按出虎、大和兒、劉伯綱等皆隨召而出，截長補短假借而用，得百餘人。

translations.literal: They also summoned capital officers to the Shangqing Palace; those who had won merit in wall defense in ordinary times, such as the clansman Anchuhu, Dahe'er, Liu Bogang, and others, all came out when summoned; cutting long to patch short and borrowing as needed, they obtained a little more than a hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Officers were summoned to the Shangqing Palace; veterans of wall defense such as Anchuhu, Dahe'er, and Liu Bogang answered the call, and by improvising from whatever was at hand they scraped together a little over a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 又集京東西沿河舊屯兩都尉及衛州已起義軍，通建威得四萬人，益以丁壯六萬，分置四城。

translations.literal: They also gathered the two commandants of the old garrisons along the river east and west of the capital and the righteous-army troops already raised at Weizhou; together with the Jianwei force they mustered forty thousand men, added sixty thousand able-bodied civilians, and distributed them among the four quarters of the city.
translations.idiomatic: They also gathered the two riverine commandants east and west of the capital and Weizhou's militia; with the Jianwei force they mustered forty thousand troops, added sixty thousand civilians, and posted them on the four sides of the city.

sentences.zh: 每面別選一千，名「飛虎軍」，以專救應，然亦不能軍矣。

translations.literal: From each face a separate thousand were chosen, named the "Flying Tiger Army," for dedicated relief, yet even so they could not form a proper army.
translations.idiomatic: Each side picked a thousand men as the "Flying Tiger Army" for rapid relief, but even then they could not muster a real force.

sentences.zh: 三月，京城被攻，大臣分守四面。

translations.literal: In the third month the capital came under attack; the great ministers divided to defend the four sides.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the capital was attacked, and senior ministers divided to hold the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 白撒主西南，受攻最急，樓櫓垂就輒摧，傳令取竹爲護簾，所司馳入城大索，竟無所得，白撒怒欲斬之。

translations.literal: Baisa held the southwest, where the attack was fiercest; towers and parapets were nearly finished and then smashed. He passed orders to take bamboo for protective screens; the responsible office galloped into the city to search widely but found nothing, and Baisa in anger wanted to behead them.
translations.idiomatic: Baisa held the southwest, the hardest-pressed sector; towers and parapets were rebuilt only to be smashed again. He ordered bamboo screens; the office searched the city in vain, and Baisa in fury wanted them executed.

sentences.zh: 員外郎張袞附所司耳語曰：「金多則濟矣，胡不即平章府求之。」

translations.literal: Bureau aide Zhang Gun whispered to the responsible officer, "Gold would solve this. Why not immediately seek it from the manager of governmental affairs' mansion?"
translations.idiomatic: Bureau aide Zhang Gun whispered to the responsible officer, "Gold would solve this. Why not immediately seek it from the manager of governmental affairs' mansion?"

sentences.zh: 所司懷金三百兩徑往，賂其家僮，果得之。

translations.literal: The officer took three hundred liang of gold and went straight there, bribed his household slaves, and indeed obtained it.
translations.idiomatic: The officer took three hundred liang of gold, bribed the household slaves, and got the bamboo.

sentences.zh: 已而兵退，朝廷議罷白撒，白撒不自安，乃謂令令史元好問曰：「我妨賢路久矣，得退是幸，爲我撰乞致仕表。」

translations.literal: After the enemy withdrew, the court discussed dismissing Baisa. Baisa was uneasy and therefore said to the clerk Yuan Haowen, "I have blocked the path of worthier men for a long time. To be allowed to withdraw would be fortunate. Draft a memorial requesting retirement for me."
translations.idiomatic: After the enemy withdrew, the court discussed dismissing Baisa. Baisa was uneasy and therefore said to the clerk Yuan Haowen, "I have blocked the path of worthier men for a long time. To be allowed to withdraw would be fortunate. Draft a memorial requesting retirement for me."

sentences.zh: 頃之，上已遣使持招至其第，令致仕。

translations.literal: Before long the emperor had already sent an envoy bearing an edict to his mansion ordering retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the emperor had already sent an envoy with orders to retire to his mansion.

sentences.zh: 既廢，軍士恨其不戰誤國，揚言欲殺之。

translations.literal: Once he was removed, soldiers resented that he had not fought and had harmed the state, and openly said they wished to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Once removed, soldiers blamed him for refusing battle and ruining the state, and openly threatened his life.

sentences.zh: 白撒懼，一夕數遷，上以親軍二百陰爲之衛。

translations.literal: Baisa was afraid and moved his lodging several times in one night; the emperor secretly sent two hundred personal guards to protect him.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Baisa changed lodgings several times in one night; the emperor secretly posted two hundred guards.

sentences.zh: 軍士無以泄其憤，遂相率毀其別墅而去。

translations.literal: The soldiers had no outlet for their anger and therefore together wrecked his suburban villa and left.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to reach him, the soldiers mobbed and wrecked his suburban villa instead.

sentences.zh: 其党元帥完顏斜撚阿不領本部軍戍汴，聞之徑詣其所，斬經其垣下者一人以鎮之。

translations.literal: His partisan Marshal Wanyan Sanianabu, leading his own troops on garrison at Bian, heard of it, went straight to the place, and beheaded one man who had crossed his wall to restore order.
translations.idiomatic: His ally Marshal Wanyan Sanianabu, garrisoning Bian with his own troops, came at once and beheaded one man who had crossed the wall to restore order.

sentences.zh: 是時，速不泬等兵散屯河南，汴城糧且盡，累召援兵復無至者。

translations.literal: At that time Subutai and others had their troops scattered in camps across Henan; grain in Bian city was nearly exhausted, and though relief armies were summoned repeatedly none arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Subutai and others then had troops scattered across Henan; Bian's grain was nearly gone, and repeated calls for relief brought no one.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，乃復起白撒爲平章政事、權樞密使、兼右副元帥。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter he was again raised as participation councillor, acting marshal commissioner, and concurrently right deputy grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Baisa was recalled as participation councillor, acting marshal commissioner, and right deputy grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 於是，群臣爲上畫出京計，以賽不爲右丞相、樞密使、兼左副元帥，內族訛出右副元帥、兼樞密副使、權參知政事，李蹊兵部尚書、權尚書左丞，徒單百家元帥左監軍、行總帥府事。

translations.literal: Thereupon the ministers outlined for the emperor a plan to leave the capital: Saibu as right chief minister, marshal commissioner, and concurrently left deputy grand marshal; the clansman Echu as right deputy grand marshal, concurrently vice marshal commissioner and acting participation councillor; Li Xi as minister of war and acting left vice director of the Secretariat; Tushan Baijia as left overseer of the marshalate and acting overall commander of the marshal headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers then outlined a plan to leave the capital: Saibu as right chief minister, marshal commissioner, and left deputy grand marshal; the clansman Echu as right deputy grand marshal, vice marshal commissioner, and acting participation councillor; Li Xi as minister of war and acting left vice director; Tushan Baijia as left marshal overseer and acting headquarters commander.

sentences.zh: 東面元帥高顯，副以果毅都尉粘合咬住兵五千。

translations.literal: Eastern marshal Gao Xian, assisted by resolute-commandant Nahan Kozhuo with five thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Marshal Gao Xian, with Resolute Commandant Nahan Kozhuo and five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 南面元帥完顏豬兒，副以建威都尉完顏斡論出兵五千。

translations.literal: Southern marshal Wanyan Zhuer, assisted by Jianwei commandant Wanyan Wolun with five thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Marshal Wanyan Zhuer, with Jianwei Commandant Wanyan Wolun and five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 西面元帥劉益、上党公張開，副以安平都尉紀綱軍五千。

translations.literal: Western marshals Liu Yi and Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai, assisted by Anping commandant Ji Gang with five thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Western Marshals Liu Yi and Duke of Shangdang Zhang Kai, with Anping Commandant Ji Gang and five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 北面元帥內族婁室，副以振威都尉張閏軍五千。

translations.literal: Northern marshal the clansman Loushi, assisted by Zhenwei commandant Zhang Run with five thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Marshal the clansman Loushi, with Zhenwei Commandant Zhang Run and five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 中翼都尉賀都善軍四千，隸總帥百家。

translations.literal: Central-wing commandant Hedushan with four thousand troops, subordinate to overall commander Baijia.
translations.idiomatic: Central-wing Commandant Hedushan with four thousand men, under Overall Commander Baijia.

sentences.zh: 都尉內族久住，副都尉王簡、總領王福胤神臂軍三千五百，左翼元帥內族小婁室親衛軍一千，右翼元帥完顏按出虎親衛軍一千，總領完顏長樂、副帥溫敦昌孫馬軍三百，郡王王義深馬軍一百五十，郡王范成進、總領蘇元孫圭軍三千，隸總帥百家。
